pred_ddx.label: Adverse local tissue reaction (ALTR) associated with metal-on-metal hip arthroplasty

Adverse local tissue reaction (ALTR) ass: The patient's presentation of persistent buttock pain, electric shock-like sensations, and elevated inflammatory markers, combined with the presence of a periprosthetic soft-tissue mass on MRI, suggests an adverse local tissue reaction (ALTR) as the most likely diagnosis.
Periprosthetic infection: Elevated inflammatory markers and the presence of a periprosthetic soft-tissue mass could also suggest a periprosthetic infection, although negative cultures and the clinical presentation lean more towards ALTR.
